title: claude start's launch brief prints the restart header when there is no restart context
body:
`compose_ctx` in intent/plugins/claude/bin/intent_claude_cwi (line 96) prints "Project restart context follows." and a rule line unconditionally, then cats $RESTART only if it exists. A project with no restart file gets a launch brief that ends on an empty section (seen 2026-11-19 by agentic-engineering-vc and -dc). The header belongs inside the same test as the file.

Reported by agentic-engineering-vc on hv's word in its window (AE hv decision 106 (5)), relayed by devbin-vc (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/20261119/intent-desk-defects.md, checked there on 3.4.0). Re-read by intent-vc on 2026-11-22 against main at 5f2da89ca (3.5.1): still live.
